name: --color-bg-default
description: The page ground. This system stays on white; there is no dark mode.

name: --color-bg-surface
description: Lavender mist. Raised surfaces that sit on the ground: cards, inputs, dialogs.

name: --color-bg-section
description: Section lavender. Tints a whole region or slide, never a card. Supports the brand's one-tint-per-section rule.

name: --color-bg-feature
description: A full-bleed indigo panel. Use white text on it (7.00:1).

name: --color-bg-celebrate
description: A full-bleed lime panel, reserved for genuine celebration. Use default text on it (12.32:1).

name: --color-border-default
description: Pale lavender hairline, never grey. Decorative only at 1.28:1 — never let a border be the sole separator between two pieces of content.

name: --color-border-strong
description: The heavier rule used to frame a photograph.

name: --color-border-focus
description: The keyboard focus ring. 7.00:1 on the ground, well past the 3:1 asked of UI boundaries.

name: --color-feedback-success
description: Correct / positive examples. NOT a body-size text colour (3.02:1 on white). Safe as a fill, an icon, a border, or large text. Default text on it reads 4.52:1.

name: --color-feedback-danger
description: Wrong / negative examples. NOT a body-size text colour (4.18:1 on white). Safe as a fill, an icon, a border, or large text. Do not put small text on it in either direction.

name: --color-neutral-100
description: Tinted fill, wireframe fill.

name: --color-neutral-200
description: The backdrop around a slide.

name: --color-neutral-300
description: Image frame, wireframe border.

name: --color-neutral-400
description: Wireframe line. Not a text colour.

name: --color-neutral-500
description: 2.41:1 on white — decorative only. Never use for text, at any size.

name: --color-neutral-600
description: The quiet text step. See color.text.muted.

name: --color-neutral-700
description: Dense body copy. 9.10:1 on the ground.

name: --color-neutral-800
description: Text on a neutral-100 fill. 10.16:1.

name: --color-neutral-900
description: The primary ink. See color.text.default.

name: --color-accent-100
description: Tinted fill behind accent text; secondary ink on indigo.

name: --color-accent-200
description: Derived step.

name: --color-accent-300
description: Chart tints, muted accents.

name: --color-accent-400
description: Derived step.

name: --color-accent-500
description: The brand indigo. Everything accent runs through this.

name: --color-accent-600
description: Hover state for indigo fills.

name: --color-accent-700
description: Pressed state for indigo fills.

name: --color-accent-800
description: Text on an accent-100 fill. 9.74:1.

name: --color-accent-900
description: Derived step, deepest.

name: --color-highlight-100
description: The palest lime fill.

name: --color-highlight-200
description: The brand lime. This ramp's base sits at 200, not 500, because the lime is a surface and not an ink.

name: --color-highlight-300
description: Derived step.

name: --color-highlight-400
description: Derived step.

name: --color-highlight-500
description: Derived step. Not the brand value — see 200.

name: --color-highlight-600
description: Derived step.

name: --color-highlight-700
description: Derived step.

name: --color-highlight-800
description: Text on a highlight-100 fill. 8.07:1. Reach here when lime has to carry text.

name: --color-highlight-900
description: Derived step, deepest.

name: --color-text-default
description: Warm near-black, never pure black. 13.67:1 on the ground.

name: --color-text-muted
description: The one quiet text step. 5.56:1 on the ground, 4.96:1 on surface. On section lavender it is 4.45:1 — large text only there.

name: --color-text-accent
description: Accent text: links, eyebrows, numerals. Safe at body size (7.00:1 on the ground).

name: --color-text-on-accent
description: Text on an indigo fill. 7.00:1.

name: --color-text-on-accent-soft
description: Secondary text on an indigo fill. 4.86:1 — passes, but leave it for supporting copy.

name: --color-text-on-highlight
description: Text on a lime fill. 12.32:1.

name: --space-xs
description: The gap inside a small control.

name: --space-sm
description: Button padding, the gap between stacked labels, table cell padding.

name: --space-md
description: Card padding and the default gap between related items. The most-used step in the system.

name: --space-lg
description: Dialog padding, the gap between groups, the space above and below a rule.

name: --space-xl
description: The gap between blocks on a page.

name: --space-2xl
description: The gap between sections. The largest step used inside a component.

name: --space-layout-48
description: Vertical rhythm between page sections.

name: --space-layout-64
description: Slide padding. The top and bottom margin of a 16:9 slide.

name: --space-layout-96
description: A generous section break, or the left margin of a title slide.

name: --space-layout-128
description: The largest step. Full-bleed breathing room.

name: --radius-sm
description: Small chrome: a page-number badge, a code block, a swatch.

name: --radius-md
description: The system's signature radius. Cards, inputs, dialogs — anything that holds content.

name: --radius-lg
description: A roomy floating panel, and the frame around a photograph.

name: --radius-pill
description: Fully round ends. Buttons, tags and segmented controls are always pills in this system.

name: --font-family-heading
description: Geometric sans, set at bold. Headings, buttons, brand marks. Free from Google Fonts; already in the Google Slides font picker.

name: --font-family-body
description: Neo-grotesque. Body copy and everything in the interface. Free from Google Fonts.

name: --font-weight-regular
description: Body copy.

name: --font-weight-bold
description: Every heading. This system sets headings at bold and nothing lighter.

name: --font-size-display
description: H1, and the headline on a title slide.

name: --font-size-title
description: H2, and a section divider slide.

name: --font-size-heading
description: H4, and a dialog title.

name: --font-size-brand
description: The wordmark in a header bar.

name: --font-size-body-lg
description: A lead paragraph, one notch above body.

name: --font-size-body
description: The default reading size.

name: --font-size-ui
description: Buttons, inputs, nav links, table cells. Deliberately one size so a button and a field sit level side by side.

name: --font-size-body-sm
description: Dense body copy, card body, and the H6 eyebrow. H6 and small body share this size — that is intentional, not a duplicate.

name: --font-size-caption
description: Field labels.

name: --font-size-label
description: Table headers, card metadata, figure captions. Anything at this size must use text.default or text.muted — nothing dimmer passes AA here.

name: --font-size-micro
description: The uppercase kicker on a card. The smallest size in the system.

name: --font-line-height-tight
description: Headings. Token value is the unitless multiplier 1.12; Figma states line height as a percentage, so it is stored here as 112%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives a line height in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-line-height-snug
description: Buttons and card titles — text that sits on one or two lines. Token value is the unitless multiplier 1.2; Figma states line height as a percentage, so it is stored here as 120%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives a line height in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-line-height-body
description: Body copy. Token value is the unitless multiplier 1.55; Figma states line height as a percentage, so it is stored here as 155%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives a line height in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-letter-spacing-tight
description: Headings. Large type needs pulling together. Token value is -0.015em; Figma states letter spacing as a percentage, so it is stored here as -1.5%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives letter spacing in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-letter-spacing-normal
description: Body copy and everything not listed here. Token value is 0em; Figma states letter spacing as a percentage, so it is stored here as 0%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives letter spacing in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-letter-spacing-wide
description: Tags. Token value is 0.02em; Figma states letter spacing as a percentage, so it is stored here as 2%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives letter spacing in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-letter-spacing-wider
description: The H6 eyebrow and table headers. Token value is 0.08em; Figma states letter spacing as a percentage, so it is stored here as 8%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives letter spacing in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --font-letter-spacing-widest
description: The card kicker, the smallest uppercase text in the system. Token value is 0.1em; Figma states letter spacing as a percentage, so it is stored here as 10%. Same value, different notation. ⚠️ DO NOT bind this variable to a text style. A number variable carries the number but not the unit, so Figma applies it as PIXELS — binding this gives letter spacing in px, not a percentage. Type the percentage into the style by hand, and keep this variable for the code, which converts it. Measured 27/08.

name: --button-radius
description: Button border radius. Aliases radius/pill for full-rounded buttons.

name: --button-focus-offset
description: Focus ring offset (3px). WCAG 2.4.13 — visible separation from button edge.

name: --button-focus-ring-width
description: Focus ring width (3px). Exceeds WCAG 2.4.13 minimum (2px) for maximum visibility.

name: --button-target-spacing
description: Minimum spacing between adjacent buttons (24px). WCAG 2.5.8 Target Spacing — ensures no accidental activation of neighboring targets.

name: --button-height-sm
description: Small button height (44px). Meets WCAG 2.5.5 AAA minimum touch target.

name: --button-height-md
description: Medium button height (48px). Meets Apple HIG & Material 3 recommended minimum.

name: --button-height-lg
description: Large button height (56px). Maximum comfort, exceeds all guidelines.

name: --button-padding-x-sm
description: Small button horizontal padding (16px). Ensures text never crowds edges.

name: --button-padding-x-md
description: Medium button horizontal padding (24px). Comfortable reading area.

name: --button-padding-x-lg
description: Large button horizontal padding (32px). Maximum legibility.

name: --button-padding-y-sm
description: Small button vertical padding (12px). Ensures 44px minimum height with text.

name: --button-padding-y-md
description: Medium button vertical padding (16px). Comfortable for 48px height.

name: --button-padding-y-lg
description: Large button vertical padding (24px). Maximum comfort for 56px height.

name: --button-gap-sm
description: Small button icon-to-label gap (8px). Clear separation for cognitive accessibility.

name: --button-gap-md
description: Medium/large button icon-to-label gap (12px). Generous spacing for clarity.

name: --button-icon-size-sm
description: Small button icon (20px). Above WCAG minimum for perceivable graphics.

name: --button-icon-size-md
description: Medium button icon (24px). Meets WCAG AAA for interactive graphic elements.

name: --button-icon-size-lg
description: Large button icon (28px). Exceeds all guidelines for maximum visibility.

name: --button-min-width-sm
description: Small button minimum width (44px). WCAG 2.5.5 AAA in both dimensions.

name: --button-min-width-md
description: Medium button minimum width (96px). Ensures comfortable label space.

name: --button-min-width-lg
description: Large button minimum width (140px). Maximum legibility and tap confidence.

name: --motion-duration-quick
description: 140ms. Colour changes and fades — anything that does not travel: a hover fill, an opacity swap. Do NOT use it for movement; at this speed a path cannot be read.

name: --motion-duration-default
description: 200ms. Movement inside the screen: something that slides from one place to another while staying visible. The nav pill travels on this one.

name: --motion-duration-slow
description: 320ms. Things that enter or leave the screen — a dialog, a drawer. Not yet used: it waits for the contact dialog. Do NOT use it for a hover; it would feel broken.

name: --motion-easing-standard
description: An object that moves while staying on screen: it leaves briskly and settles. The default curve — reach for this one first, and pair it with duration.default.

name: --motion-easing-enter
description: Something arriving: full speed at the start, gentle landing. Pair with duration.slow. Only for what comes from outside the screen.

name: --motion-easing-exit
description: Something leaving: gentle start, then gone. Pair with duration.slow. Never on something that stays — it reads as a departure.

name: --nav-height
description: The height of the nav bar when it sticks to the top: a tab, plus the air the pill puts around it, plus the air the bar puts around the pill. 88 above 768, 72 below. A page reads it to sit its first screen under the bar — it is the number the case study peek depends on. Same in both Nav states: the avatar is exactly as tall as the pill.

name: --card-title-size
description: Card title size. Aliases font/size/title — the same step an H2 takes. Named so the text of a card can be retuned without moving page headings.

name: --card-title-color
description: Card title ink. Aliases color/text/default. 15.3:1 on color/bg/default, which is what a card is painted with.

name: --card-subtitle-size
description: Card subtitle size. Aliases font/size/body-lg — one step above body, so the line under the title reads before the secondary one.

name: --card-subtitle-color
description: Card subtitle ink. Aliases color/text/default: the subtitle carries meaning, so it reads at full strength and is not muted.

name: --card-meta-size
description: Card secondary info size. Aliases font/size/body — a date, a place, an author. Read after the subtitle, so it does not shrink below body.

name: --card-meta-color
description: Card secondary info ink. Aliases color/text/muted. 5.56:1 on color/bg/default — the only quiet step, and it stays above 4.5:1 on the card.

name: --control-size
description: The side of a compact control's box — radio, checkbox. Both are drawn at 18.

name: --control-track-height
description: The height of a switch track. Its width needs no variable: 40 is space/xl + space/lg exactly.

name: --control-field-gap
description: The vertical gap between a field's label, its box and its counter. Not the gap between a compact control and its word — that one is space/sm.

name: --border-width-default
description: The resting stroke of a field, a box, a chip. The system's only one: drawn 217 times across five pages.

name: --border-width-focus
description: The focus mark. Every control that carries one draws it at 2. Supersedes button/focus-ring-width, which draws nothing — the Button has no Focused state.

name: --opacity-disabled
description: How far a disabled object fades, in percent — Figma stores opacity the way it stores line-height. One value for all of them, where the file had drawn 40, 50 and 60 for the same intent.
